description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his late 30s, wearing a crisp dark blue Polis Diraja Malaysia (PDRM) uniform with silver badges and rank insignia on the shoulders. He has a clean-cut short hairstyle and polished black leather boots.
FULL BODY. A young Malaysian woman in her early 20s wearing a simple, slightly faded t-shirt, loose-fitting denim jeans, and worn canvas shoes. She has a slender build and neatly tied back dark hair.
FULL BODY. A featureless human-shaped silhouette made of glowing digital matrix code and glitching pixels, wearing a translucent suit-shaped outline to mimic a professional appearance.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian elderly couple in their late 60s. The man wears a traditional batik shirt and slacks, and the woman wears a modest floral baju kurung with a matching tudung (headscarf). They wear simple sandals.
FULL BODY. An anonymous human figure completely obscured in a matte black tactical bodysuit and a smooth, featureless reflective glass mask that hides all facial features.
